Groups that run on the VM runner no longer lose messages, and the app shows the bots that are working in them.

## Install

**One command** in PowerShell. It installs Hermes Agent too if it's missing, checks the installer against `SHA256SUMS.txt`, and opens the app:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nexurlabs/nexur-bots/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Or by hand:** download **`NexurBots-Setup-1.8.18.exe`** below and run it. It installs over earlier versions and keeps your settings and chats.

- **Not code-signed.** If you download the installer in a browser, Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**. The one-command install doesn't get that prompt.
- No auto-update: install a newer `NexurBots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one.

## Changes

- **No more lost group messages.** A group is saved by both this app and the VM runner. A save could overwrite the other one's newest messages. Now a save takes in the other side's messages first, and a save that keeps losing retries instead of dropping them. Deleting a group here stays deleted. Work notes get the same fix.
- **Working bots show in groups the runner runs.** The dots and "working now" appear while a bot works there, the same as in groups this app runs. The app checks every few seconds while such a group is open, and a bot that the runner has not reported for three minutes stops showing as working.

## Older versions

Install 1.8.18 on every computer that opens a group the VM runs. Older versions can overwrite a group's newest messages when the runner and the app save the same group at the same time, and they don't show a runner group's bots as working.
